policy: Approved features never disappear silently. Removing an entry fails the Feature Registry gate; an intentional removal is a status change to 'deprecated' with deprecation.approved_by (owner), date and migration. Emergency safety / legal fixes may change behaviour with an auditable 'exception' entry in history. Status words in the Command Center: WORKING / DEGRADED / DISABLED / FAILED / UNVERIFIED.

features.name: Universal Decision Brain (search readiness, one next question)
features.purpose: Understand the need from the whole conversation and decide whether a search is justified now.
features.expected_behavior: decide() returns mode, state, search_ready, ONE next_question and a consolidated search_subject; known facts are never asked again; a product noun alone never triggers cards.

features.name: Reasoning before results (guidance + goal planning)
features.purpose: Every reply genuinely helps first; cards support the answer, never replace it.
features.expected_behavior: Guidance with the user's own numbers, labelled estimates, goal / resource planning when something must get done, at most one question; a false results claim drops only its sentence.

features.name: One-time advice memory
features.purpose: Advise once, respect the decision, keep helping.
features.expected_behavior: A concern repeats only for new information, an explicit ask or a critical risk; the ledger is kept per conversation.

features.name: Result Board (above the conversation, same Home screen)
features.purpose: Show relevant results without covering the conversation, input or avatar.
features.expected_behavior: hidden / loading / expanded / minimized pill / restored / pinned selection / stale / archived; sized from the real Home column height; minimize and restore reflow the chat; a retired deck is archived and restorable; default board keeps the locked one-rail layout; mega expand shows one box per category with up/down, swipe and an n/N counter whose position survives minimize; a provider failure is a separate notice, never 'no results'.

features.name: Result Contract v2 (sections, honest empties)
features.purpose: One versioned backend-to-app result contract for every source.
features.expected_behavior: /deals/discover and /deals/{id}/matches return sections, conversation_state, answer.may_claim_results and matches; a failing source empties only its own section.

features.name: Online / local / mixed discovery channel
features.purpose: Route discovery to the channel the user asked for.
features.expected_behavior: An online ask never shows nearby shop cards and always runs the online search; a local ask skips the web search; a channel switch never leaves old cards posing as the answer.

features.name: Structured reply rendering
features.purpose: Readable answers in any language: headings, points, bold, tables, links -- never raw markup.
features.expected_behavior: Assistant replies render their structure; plain replies stay plain; speech gets plain words; lines the assistant tags [ok]/[caution]/[risk] are coloured green/orange/red with an icon (never keyword-guessed); tall scripts get 1.5 line height.

features.name: Photo / video / document understanding
features.purpose: Understand media sent with or without words, without assuming a purchase.
features.expected_behavior: One analyze endpoint; media alone is explained, never searched; honest failures.

features.name: Continuous voice (Sarvam STT / TTS)
features.purpose: Speak naturally until Stop; replies spoken in the conversation language.
features.expected_behavior: Recording ends on the user's Stop; long silence (8 s) and 2 min are safety limits; Telugu preserved; no markup spoken; ONE audio lifecycle -- a newer reply or Stop cuts the old one off and it never falls back to a second voice.

features.name: Message actions (copy / select / share / replay)
features.purpose: Every message can be copied, selected and shared; replies can be replayed aloud.
features.expected_behavior: Long-press a message: Copy (plain text, no markup), Select text, Share through the Android share sheet (the user chooses; nothing is posted by ASKODOX); replies add Replay aloud and Mute / Unmute voice replies.

features.name: Conversation -> profile memory (roles, needs, offers)
features.purpose: Remember what a person needs / offers, by role, privately and under their control.
features.expected_behavior: Requests become items on the ONE profile by role (buyer / seller / service_provider / service_taker = seeking services or jobs); the same need updates (history kept), never duplicates; statuses active / updated / completed / cancelled / expired; private by default, public only with explicit consent and never with contacts; OTPs, passwords, card / account / Aadhaar / PAN numbers never stored; view, correct, delete one / all, switch off; strictly per user; removed with the account.

features.name: Profile -> My Roles / My Business navigation (Home unchanged)
features.purpose: One personal identity, role sections, and one My Business hub -- never a tile on Home.
features.expected_behavior: Profile -> My roles shows the personal profile once and, per held role (buyer, service taker, seller, service provider), tiles that open real screens; a role not held offers 'Add this role'. Profile -> My business: counted summary + insights (Analytics) first, then sections Business profile, My listings, Promotions & coupons, Business orders (plus Conversations & automation, Business settings and My creations as they ship). Promotions create offers that ASKODOX reviews before customers see them.

features.name: Conversations & Automation workspace (sellers)
features.purpose: Auto replies from approved answers only, handover, hours, preview and real platform status.
features.expected_behavior: ON/OFF auto-replies in ASKODOX chats from the seller's approved answers (templates); handover words and out-of-hours always reach the owner; a customer message can be tried before saving; Facebook / Instagram / WhatsApp show Connected only after a verified connection (else needs setup / test mode / not available); conversation history opens the real inbox; nothing is posted to any platform from here.

features.name: Admin API Health & Billing
features.purpose: Per provider: real state, failure type, credits, usage, cost and alerts -- never an invented balance, never a recharge.
features.expected_behavior: Brave credits from its own X-RateLimit headers; other balances UNKNOWN or a labelled ESTIMATE from an admin budget; actual cost UNKNOWN (provider bill); failure types billing_quota / credential / rate_limit / downtime; alerts at 20/10/5/0% remaining, spend spikes and repeated failures, once per period, acknowledge / resolve; no recharge endpoint exists.

features.name: Admin AI incidents + action framework
features.purpose: Explain what is wrong from real telemetry and act only through approved, verified, auditable steps.
features.expected_behavior: Incidents in ONE format (Problem / Impact / Reason / Evidence / Solution / Action Status / Retest / AI Explanation) in English or Telugu; Reason confirmed only from the provider's own answer, else 'Root cause not confirmed'; correlations labelled POSSIBLE_CORRELATION; history kept; release readiness never READY without device proof. Actions only from a fixed catalog: read-only checks may run (max 2/hour), changes need approval by the right permission, are verified (VERIFIED / NOT_RECOVERED / UNVERIFIED), keep rollback, and are blocked after two failed recoveries.

features.name: My Business -> My Creations
features.purpose: Posts, descriptions, offer / catalogue / poster text and reel scripts the owner keeps and shares.
features.expected_behavior: Write by hand or draft with AI from the owner's facts only (missing facts stay [placeholders]; no invented prices or claims); saved per owner; edit / copy / share through the phone's share sheet; nothing posted automatically; image generation and video generation shown as NOT_AVAILABLE with the reason; video is upload-only.

features.name: Strict release gate
features.purpose: No release is marked READY while any condition fails or real-phone verification is missing.
features.expected_behavior: Code conditions (approved features intact, Home unchanged, no recharge route, no unbacked generation claims) run in CI; runtime: no red incident; device: every phone check PHONE VERIFIED. READY only when all PASS; otherwise NOT_READY or BLOCKED_ON_DEVICE_VERIFICATION. Visible in Integration readiness.

features.name: Header location control (the one place to change location)
features.purpose: One location control; the companion menus never duplicate it.
features.expected_behavior: Header chip changes the place; companion ring / floating menu offer no Location action.

features.name: Truthful provider readiness + Check now
features.purpose: Admins see real provider state, never key presence.
features.expected_behavior: LIVE only after a real answer; QUOTA_EXHAUSTED / NEEDS_CONFIGURATION / ERROR distinguished; no secrets.

features.name: Assistant feature health + self-heal verified recovery
features.purpose: Real user-facing outcomes and recoveries that are proven, not assumed.
features.expected_behavior: No traffic = unknown; an applied fix is UNVERIFIED until evidence shows VERIFIED / NOT_RECOVERED.

features.name: Universal Advisor (configurable decision fields)
features.purpose: Category questions from Command Center configuration, never keyword scripts.
features.expected_behavior: A required unanswered field holds results unless the user asks to see them; the brain's answer is kept with the advisor's one question.

features.name: Owner-only encrypted database backup with verified restore
features.purpose: Take a recoverable backup of the production SQLite database without Railway volume backups.
features.expected_behavior: Owner key only (staff refused); read-only snapshot; AES-256-GCM with a passphrase that is never stored; a restore into an isolated database must pass integrity_check + row counts + SHA-256 before the file is offered; one-time download; no row contents in any response, log or audit entry.

features.name: Universal catalogue + attribute master (admin-editable) with real buyer filters
features.purpose: One data-driven engine for every business type: templates, inherited attributes, indexed listing attributes, filters from real listings.
features.expected_behavior: catalog_templates resource seeded once and editable; parent inheritance; required / conditional / multi / number / unit attributes; missing price or required detail keeps a draft; contact details never in attributes; filters list only values real active listings carry.

features.name: Travel Radio add-on (separate billing, plans inactive)
features.purpose: Location-aware audio segments from real facts while travelling, sold as an add-on separate from the base plan.
features.expected_behavior: Plans radio_1d/7d/30d (proposed Rs 29/149/399) seeded INACTIVE in growth_plans (audience addon_radio); /api/subscriptions refuses add-ons; paid passes stay PENDING_PAYMENT; only staff promotional passes grant access and only with flag radio.enabled (default off); segments only from geocoding / Places / LIVE content; audio cached; no repeats within radio.repeat_hours; daily minute cap; cost model light/medium/heavy labelled ESTIMATE.

features.name: ASKODOX Executive AI (AXE) brief
features.purpose: One graded executive brief for the Owner over the release gate, incidents, API spend, Travel Radio pricing and the Feature Registry.
features.expected_behavior: GET /admin/cc/axe/brief (health:view) returns overall + findings graded CONFIRMED / POSSIBLE / ESTIMATE / PENDING and owner_decisions; recommends only admin_action_framework.CATALOG actions (never runs them); en / te templates, no model call.

features.name: Smart Fill for the ready-made catalogue (seller's own words only)
features.purpose: Fill a template's details from what the seller types, for any category, without guessing.
features.expected_behavior: POST /api/catalog/templates/{key}/smart-fill (signed in, rate-limited) returns values only for options named in the text, numbers next to the attribute's name / unique unit, or explicit 'name: value'; ambiguous choices stay empty; clean_attributes rules apply (conditions, ranges, no contact details); the app fills only EMPTY fields and never replaces the seller's price or choices; nothing is saved until Publish.

features.name: Free / Plus / Pro plans (Plus and Pro inactive until billing is approved)
features.purpose: Show the owner's proposed base plans honestly without selling anything before approval.
features.expected_behavior: Plans free (Rs 0, active), plus (Rs 499 / 30 d), pro (Rs 999 / 30 d, 7-day trial) seeded once with audience 'base' (staff edits never overwritten); Plus / Pro INACTIVE; GET /api/plans/catalogue lists them with available + billing not_available; /api/subscriptions refuses inactive plans; app Plans screen shows 'Not available yet' with no button; /admin/subscriptions (old mock screen) redirects to the Command Center.

features.name: Travel Radio internal testers (admin-controlled, no billing)
features.purpose: Let staff-chosen testers use Travel Radio in production while the customer flag stays off.
features.expected_behavior: POST /admin/cc/radio/testers and DELETE /admin/cc/radio/testers/{user_id} (growth:manage); a tester gets status internal_testing + access and /api/radio/next works with radio.enabled OFF, with no pass and no price; usage still metered and capped; non-testers get 503 RADIO_DISABLED.

features.name: Travel Radio tester management in the Command Center (audited, kill switch, billing off)
features.purpose: Staff add / remove internal Radio testers from the console without API calls.
features.expected_behavior: Console view radioadmin (growth:view; changes need growth:manage); every add / remove audited (radio.tester.add / radio.tester.remove); flag radio.internal_testing (default ON) is the kill switch for tester access; customer flag radio.enabled stays OFF; billing INACTIVE; a pass plan's entitlements.limits.radio_minutes_per_day tightens the daily cap.

features.name: Delivery partner document check + staff test delivery
features.purpose: No independent partner takes jobs before staff have seen the required documents; staff can rehearse a delivery with one real approved partner.
features.expected_behavior: delivery_partners carry docs_checked (staff tick what they saw; numbers never stored beyond last 4); motor vehicles need driving_licence + vehicle_rc + insurance, others id_proof; going online returns 409 documents_pending until ticked; matching skips partners with missing documents; POST /admin/cc/mobility/test-job (delivery:manage) offers a test_run job to ONE approved, checked partner without a fare.

features.name: Push notification readiness + staff test send (FCM, honest NOT_CONFIGURED)
features.purpose: Show exactly what is missing for background push and let staff test a real send once credentials exist.
features.expected_behavior: GET /admin/cc/push/readiness (health:view) -> NOT_CONFIGURED / SERVER_READY_NO_DEVICES / READY_UNVERIFIED + android_client NOT_BUILT + missing steps; POST /admin/cc/push/test (integrations:manage) -> 409 NOT_CONFIGURED without credentials, NO_DEVICE_TOKENS, SENT or NOT_DELIVERED (respects the user's switches), audited.

features.name: In-app update installs only a checksum-verified APK, after user confirmation
features.purpose: Never install a corrupted or substituted APK; never install silently.
features.expected_behavior: latest.json carries sha256 + signer_cert_sha256; the release API path uses the GitHub asset digest; downloadAndInstall computes the file's SHA-256 and refuses (deletes the file) when it is missing or differs; the user confirms in the app dialog and in Android's installer.

features.name: Plans & pricing console + live-pricing switch + billing readiness
features.purpose: Staff configure prices, trials and usage limits; nothing goes on sale or is charged without the Owner.
features.expected_behavior: Console view plansadmin; PUT /admin/cc/growth/plans/{code} refuses an active paid plan with 409 LIVE_PRICING_OFF while flag billing.live_pricing (default OFF) is off; entitlements.limits must be numbers >= 0; GET /admin/cc/growth/billing-readiness reports gateway / switch / on-sale checks and collection INACTIVE until all pass.

features.name: Razorpay + Cashfree adapters (official APIs), TEST mode, Live mode locked
features.purpose: Take payments through an individual / sole-proprietor merchant account once a gateway approves it, starting in sandbox only.
features.expected_behavior: Cashfree adapter (2023-08-01: orders -> payment_session_id, webhook base64 HMAC of timestamp+body, stale replays refused, refunds); Razorpay refunds; checkout provider = the gateway in TEST/LIVE (ASKODOX_PAYMENT_PROVIDER picks); live mode and live keys refused (LIVE_MODE_LOCKED) unless ASKODOX_PAYMENTS_LIVE_APPROVED=yes; a full refund webhook ends REFUNDED.

features.name: Subscription + Travel Radio billing (activate only on gateway-confirmed payment)
features.purpose: Sell base plans and the separate Radio add-on through one payment layer, safely.
features.expected_behavior: POST /api/billing/checkout (TEST: billing testers only; LIVE: owner approvals + on sale); POST /api/billing/razorpay/verify checks the checkout signature; plan / pass activates only on PAID, idempotent; refund requested by staff (confirm) through the gateway and the plan / pass ends on the refund webhook; Radio pass separate from the base plan; no card data stored; staff GET /admin/cc/billing/status, testers, refunds (console view billingadmin).

features.name: Android FCM client (token registration, refresh, foreground display, tap routing)
features.purpose: Background push on phones once Firebase values exist, without committing config files.
features.expected_behavior: Firebase initialised from build-time variables FIREBASE_API_KEY / APP_ID / SENDER_ID / PROJECT_ID (Live Build repository variables); without them sync() is notConfigured and nothing is called; with them: permission, token -> POST /api/me/push-token, onTokenRefresh re-registers, foreground messages shown via the local channel, taps open only in-app routes; account deletion unregisters; delivery / subscription / radio events push to the requester.

features.name: Razorpay TEST mode: hosted checkout, verification, reconciliation, audit
features.purpose: Let billing testers pay for approved plans with Razorpay TEST keys from the deployment variables, with no real money and no client-trusted amount or success.
features.expected_behavior: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID (rzp_test_) + RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET alone enable Razorpay in TEST mode (staff settings override; webhook secret optional); GET /api/billing/options lists what the server lets this user pay for; checkout returns pay_url -> GET /billing/pay/{id}?t= (30-minute purchase-bound token) opening Razorpay Standard Checkout with server amount / order / key; success verified by HMAC signature bound to the purchase's own order; closing = CANCELLED; failed attempts keep the order PENDING (retry); a later capture still activates; webhooks need the right amount + currency and are deduplicated; open purchases are read back from Razorpay (GET only, never refunds or captures) and expire after 24 h; refunds only by staff with confirmation, status read back; every step in billing_events; Radio billing behind billing.radio_checkout (OFF); live keys LIVE_MODE_LOCKED; /health/integrations Razorpay row is secret-free.

features.name: One Razorpay gateway state (read-only key check, webhook evidence) + TEST payments never entitle
features.purpose: Every admin screen tells the same verified truth about the payment gateway, and sandbox money never unlocks a paid plan.
features.expected_behavior: payment_gateway_health.check: authenticated read-only GET /v1/payments?count=1 (cached 15 min, forced at most once a minute by POST /admin/cc/api-billing/razorpay/check, audited); a pass is recorded so Integration readiness shows TEST_MODE_VERIFIED / health TEST_VERIFIED; only HTTP 401 records a failure (CREDENTIAL_ERROR, checkout off); API Health & Billing has a Razorpay row with mode, key kind, key check, webhook signing, verified webhook events and rejected signatures; no key, secret or signature in any response; a TEST purchase confirmed by the gateway becomes TEST_PAID with no subscription / pass, only a LIVE purchase becomes ACTIVE; testers can be added by phone number; the app shows the server's reason when there is no Pay button.
